## Rules

Every statement is a pure move: nothing edited, reformatted or reordered on its way across, an added `export` keyword the only permitted change. Never split an action — `redirect()` must stay outside the `try` in `saveAnnouncement` and `deleteFlag`, and moving whole declarations is what keeps that. Keep each leaf's exports as whole `export async function` declarations with no non-exported helper wedged between two of them, or `admin-moderation`'s `body()` will read it as part of the preceding action. Do not merge `FLAG_VERSION_RE` and `VERSION_RE` ([[BAD-050]]). A bug found on the way is a `proposal file`, never a fix. Do not touch `server/**` or `admin/src/lib/actions/support.ts` and `auth-admin.ts`.

The project's skills govern how this is built and verified: `implementing-changes`, `sizing-modules`, `committing-and-pushing`. Read `admin/CLAUDE.md` and `admin/README.md` § Verifying a change. Note that running `next dev` appends to the tracked `admin/CLAUDE.md` ([[BAD-072]]); if it happens, leave it and say so — Spud drops that hunk before committing.
